description: An index with a negative number key makes static traversal analysis an error
notes: The spec allows constant index operations in a static traversal without defining constant, and -1 has a constant value, though the grammar has no negative literals, so it negates the literal 1. hashicorp/hcl only makes an index a traversal step when its key is a literal value or a string literal (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go); any other key gives an IndexExpr, which has no AsTraversal method.
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
